name: Maternity leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.37–44 and First Schedule para.2(5): Part IX applies to covered female employees and excludes domestic employees. Section 37 grants at least 98 consecutive days per confinement. Allowance eligibility requires at least 90 days in aggregate with the employer during the nine months immediately before confinement and employment with that employer at some time during the four months immediately before confinement (s.37(2)(a)); the surviving-natural-child limit is in ss.37(1)(c)–(d). Service with unrelated employers is not added to qualify against this employer. Sections 37(2)(d)–(3) separately govern multiple-employer claims and contributions. More favourable contractual benefits remain separate.

name: Hospitalisation leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(bb) — 60 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year where hospitalisation is necessary, IN ADDITION to the s.60F(1)(aa) days since the Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 deleted the former 60-day aggregate proviso. Certification is required. No proration.

name: Medical leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(aa)(i)-(iii) — 14, 18 or 22 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year by length of service, where no hospitalisation is necessary. s.60F(1) makes examination by a registered medical practitioner or dental surgeon, or by a medical officer, a condition of the entitlement, so a certificate is required from the FIRST day; s.60F(2) deems sick absence without that certificate to be absence without leave. s.60F carries no proration clause and the entitlement must not be prorated. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 2): Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 reg.8(1): a part-time employee’s sick leave is 10 days under two years’ service, 13 from two to under five, 15 from five; none on a non-working day (reg.8(2)).

name: Annual leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60E(1) — 8 days of paid annual leave for less than two years of continuous service, 12 days for two but less than five, and 16 days for five or more. The closing words of s.60E(1) give an employee who has not completed twelve months of continuous service during the year in which the contract terminates an entitlement in direct proportion to the number of COMPLETED MONTHS of service, which is the proration below. Applied 2026-09-18 (2): EA s.60E(1): a fraction of a day under a half is disregarded and a half or more is a day (`rounding: WHOLE_DAY`). Applied 2026-09-23 (round 2): EA s.60E(3A) proviso — no pay-out where the employee is dismissed under s.14(1)(a); `encash_on_exit_when` withholds the exit pay-out on a DISMISSAL recorded as `misconduct_dismissal`. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 2): EA s.60E(3B) — leave of absence without pay exceeding thirty days in aggregate in any twelve months is disregarded in computing the length of service "under this section", so the ladder reads `employment.service_months_net(["UNPAID_LEAVE"], 30.0)`: each twelve months of service counted from the start, the calendar days of approved UNPAID_LEAVE in it disregarded where they exceed thirty. Unauthorised ABSENCE is not leave granted and is not netted; s.60F's sick-leave ladder is another section and keeps plain service. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 2): Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations 2010 (P.U.(A) 302/2010) reg.7(1): a part-time employee’s annual leave is 6 days under two years’ service, 8 from two to under five, 11 from five — a ladder of its own, not the full-timer’s days prorated by hours.

name: Paternity leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60FA — seven consecutive days of paid paternity leave per confinement for a MARRIED male employee who has been employed by the same employer for at least twelve months immediately before the leave begins (s.60FA(1) and (3)(a)); the eligibility predicate carries all three conditions. Not modelled: the s.60FA(3)(b) requirement that the employee notify the employer of the confinement at least thirty days before the expected confinement or as early as possible after it — neither has a home in the entitlement shape. Applied 2026-09-18: seven days per confinement (`event.kind == "BIRTH"`), up to five confinements in a lifetime irrespective of the number of spouses (s.60FA(1), (2); `lifetime_events`).

name: National service leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265) s.18A(d), AGC reprint as at 1 August 2023 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf, read 2026-09-30): a monthly-rated employee who took leave of absence by reason of having been called up for national service under the National Service Act 1952, to present himself for national service training under the National Service Training Act 2003 or to comply with any other written law relating to national service is paid for that month monthly wages x days eligible / days of the wage period — the same s.18A formula as unpaid leave, so the leave is unpaid (is_npl) and the days are its own class, not UNPAID_LEAVE.
